newsitem.title: USA: Union Bank to underwrite Quezon financing. [CORRECTED 15:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Union Bank to underwrite Quezon financing. [CORRECTED 15:00 GMT]

text.p: Ogden Corp said Union Bank of Switzerland will underwrite up to $660 million of bank financing for the Quezon Power Project, a 500 megawatt (Corrects from 50 megawatt) coal-fired power generation facility and 31 kilometer transmission line interconnect to be located on the island of Luzon in the Philippines.

Besides Ogden's Ogden Energy Inc subsidiary, the project is sponsored by PMR Power Inc, a Philippine power development company and International Generating Co, a partnership of Bechtel Enterprises Inc and Pacific Gas & Electric Co.
(Corrects from Public Service Enterprise Group Inc).
In addition to the UBS facility, Ogden said, the project financing of some $860 million will include a Section 144A bond issue and a $200 million equity investment by the sponsors.
It said the UBS bank credit facility will be structured to include:
-- a $387 million construction loan supported by a political risk guarantee expected to be issued by the U.S. Export-Import Bank,
-- $58 million of project letters of credit, and
-- a $215 million alternative construction and term loan facility which will be available for use as a back stop financing.
The project will sell electricity to Manila Electric Co under a 25-year power sales agreement. Commercial operation is scheduled for lat 1999, Ogden said.
It noted the Quezon Project will not rely on any Philippine government performance guarantees.
